scripts.dev: pnpm run build && sh -c 'node_modules/.bin/tsc --watch -p tsconfig.build.json & compiler=$!; trap "kill $compiler 2>/dev/null || true" EXIT; node --watch --enable-source-maps dist/src/server.js'
scripts.api:schema: pnpm run build && GLOWLOOM_AGENT_EXPORT_OPENAPI=1 vitest run tests/openapi.test.ts
scripts.api:check: pnpm run api:schema && pnpm run api:check-go && vitest run tests/business-openapi.test.ts && pnpm run api:typecheck
scripts.api:check-go: sh -ec 'generated=$(mktemp); trap "rm -f $generated" EXIT; go -C ../backend tool oapi-codegen -generate types,client -package runtimeclient -o "$generated" ../agent/node_modules/.cache/openapi/agent.json; cmp "$generated" ../backend/internal/agent/adapter/runtimeclient/generated.go'
scripts.api:generate-go: pnpm run api:schema && go -C ../backend tool oapi-codegen -generate types,client -package runtimeclient -o internal/agent/adapter/runtimeclient/generated.go ../agent/node_modules/.cache/openapi/agent.json
scripts.api:typecheck: tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --skipLibCheck false --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2024 --verbatimModuleSyntax --types node src/business/generated/*.ts
